stages.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: standalone macOS app icon concept for Vibechar, a tiny, extremely fast native text workbench. Established identity is exactly "V_" (uppercase Latin V immediately followed by a low horizontal underscore, like a terminal cursor). Preserve this exact two-character mark, with a bold custom monospaced geometric V, crisp diagonals, optically balanced spacing, no serifs. This mark is the entire subject. Front-facing orthographic square icon, absolutely no perspective. One generously rounded macOS-style square tile occupying approximately 86% of a square 1024x1024 canvas, centered, with genuinely transparent exterior and clean edges. Large mark fills roughly two-thirds of the tile width and has substantial strokes so it reads clearly in the Dock at 32px. Sophisticated tactile product design, disciplined and distinctive; extremely restrained depth, precise edges, beautiful proportions and negative space. No words other than V_, no labels, no layout boards, no extra symbols, no sparkle, no stars, no robot, no pencil, no document page, no generic AI gradient, no extra outline frames, no surrounding objects, no mockup scene. Deliver one icon only, centered, not a presentation.
Direction: GRAPHITE INSTRUMENT. A dark graphite (#20211F) tile, silky dense matte finish, beautifully precise softly beveled perimeter, no metallic brushed texture. The V is warm ivory (#E3E5DF), a beautifully machined solid inlay with a very subtle chamfer and small physical depth, broad clean strokes. The low underscore is peach-orange (#F49A6B), a tiny solid luminous enamel inlay, vivid but no neon bloom. A dark tool you want to touch, confident and sleek, restrained sculptural highlights. The corners are softly round, the icon is calm and richly finished, no glass bubbles or ornament. Warm ivory V and orange cursor remain the dominant unmistakable graphic.

stages.intent: Generate a clean studio preview using the initial concept as a design reference
stages.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a NEW polished macOS app icon concept preview, using Image 1 only as an appearance/design reference for the icon. Reference is not an edit target. Icon design: silky dark graphite tile, warm ivory V, peach-orange cursor, the exact bold geometric uppercase "V_" mark. Preserve the reference's pleasing letter proportions, spacing, tactile material and refined tile design. Render one icon, strictly front-facing, centered, on a perfectly uniform, completely opaque light warm neutral studio background (#EAE8E3) covering every pixel of the canvas. The rounded-square icon occupies about 78% of the square composition. Give it a crisp clean continuous antialiased perimeter and very soft understated contact shadow. Absolutely no transparent or black exterior, no splatters, no floating fragments, no noise, no grain, no debris, no noisy halos; do not reproduce the faulty perimeter artifacts in the reference. Deliver a beautifully finished native macOS icon on this clean solid neutral background, visually strong at small size. One icon only. No extra text, labels, interface, caption, decoration or surrounding objects. Square image.

stages.intent: Extract the selected tile on genuine transparency, preserving the design
stages.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset: FINAL transparent macOS app icon, not a mockup. Image 1 is the edit target. Remove ONLY the light gray/ivory studio background outside the graphite rounded-square icon, including any external studio shadow or pale matte. Keep the black graphite tile and the entire warm ivory V and peach-orange underscore exactly as they are: same position, size, proportions, raised lettering, material, highlights and colors. No design changes. A single smooth, clean antialiased rounded-square silhouette, all interior tile pixels opaque, all exterior pixels alpha zero, no detached pixels, no stray specks, no white halo, no black matte, no rough or torn edges. Genuinely transparent corners and margins. Keep generous equal transparent padding about 8–10% on each side, with the original tile centered, front-facing and square. Professional clean alpha cutout of this exact selected design. No caption, no new elements.
